name: test-unit
title: Unit health report
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Installed-setup health, current evidence and an opt-in completion rule.
description: Checks observed status, metadata, launch paths, logs and installed offline tests. Versioned setup identity, observed generations and recorded receipts back an opt-in Unit completion rule, owner exceptions and integration skip explanations. Publishes NOT VERIFIED and a Testing settings page when evidence is absent or stale. The rule defaults off. The CLI remains available if the extension is off; this is cooperative policy, not a prose veto or universal runtime guard.

works_with.without: Integration evidence is unavailable; an explicit skip explanation is required when Unit is required.
Performance evidence is unavailable; recommendations never gate completion.
